author: Stimulating
body:
Ok, just a small suggestion that could make players SLIGHTLY more happy. 

There seems to be a lot of deadlines that are promised that aren't met, this is not to bash the staff team, but here's my suggestion. If you're going to promise a deadline you can't fulfill, don't make the promise, set the deadline later. IMO, promising an impossible deadline and not often fulfilling it is worse than promising a later deadline you can fufill. 

It seems unprofessional to not meet deadlines, so make further ones that you can manage. 

This is not hating on anyone, nor bashing anyone, this is just a suggestion to take into account.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
For development, deadlines are difficult to meet. From what I'm aware, we are no longer confirming things for the future but rather currently. At least from my stance, I've been having some things internally done and when completed, I just make a post instead of saying soon and I try to reach out.

We do our best to plan, and we try not to promise, but things ARE met eventually. Look at Avicade, Avicore, new rules, new developers, new mapdevs, staff reassessments, and more community events. You just have to be patient, I can't think of anything promised that hasn't been done.

Something to note; forget about parkour, that was like 3 years ago.

replies.author: ImRaging
replies.body:
IMO they shouldn't set deadlines until they are near ready to release it. You could wait until near completion and then be like "Hey, there's an update coming soon." Then, you can spend a few weeks perfecting it and then release it. This way you don't get anyone's hopes up.

I guess you could argue that if you don't say that there's an update, for a while, then people are likely to leave due to the fact that 'Avicus isn't improving and the map devs are doing nothing' when behind the scenes they are.

But yeah, this is just my opinion.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Okay. You want to bring up the nise update and tourney again? Well, here goes. We aren't going to stick with this version forever and the nise update is an entire rehaul of avicus as we know it through almost every platform. We never promised for a set release date, though the name was misleading and as I said it's going to come. I can't say "soon" because you guys don't trust it, but atm the entire staff team is stressed to just meet everyone's demands.

Tournament? Scrim servers, maps, ranks, and everything else is needed to phase through AFTER the update. Oh wait, we also have opened up map submissions for the tournament and allowed referee applications and will release some info about it when we can. The last tournament was a fail and everything is planned out, up to the update to see how things roll.
